submissions.suggestedProjectName: Stargate Doña Ana County (a.k.a. "Project Jupiter") — tracked slug stargate-dona-ana-county
submissions.note: TRACKED PROJECT STATUS CHANGE / LEGAL DELAY: this is our existing 'Stargate Doña Ana County' project (Oracle/OpenAI/SoftBank, UNDER_CONSTRUCTION), locally known as 'Project Jupiter.' submissions.title: Mendocino County adopts temporary data center moratorium
submissions.excerpt: Supervisors voted 5-0 to adopt an urgency ordinance barring any new data center in the unincorporated county
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Mendocino County, California's Board of Supervisors voted 5-0 at its Sept 1 2026 meeting to adopt a 45-day urgency ordinance (effective immediately, runs to Oct 16 2026) barring approval of any new data center countywide. Rationale: existing county code has no data-center definition/regulation, so one could otherwise be approved via a routine building permit. A public hearing on Oct 6 2026 will consider extending the ban up to two years while permanent rules are drafted. This is a pre-emptive, countywide restriction — no specific project is targeted, and no BEP-tracked project is currently sited in Mendocino County, so there's nothing to link this to; flagging for the siting-restrictions dataset generally. CAVEAT: WebFetch was unavailable this run to verify the excerpt verbatim against the article; treat as a close paraphrase from search summaries pending confirmation.
